fun ar x x_1 =>
  List.brecOn.{1, 0} (motive := fun x => TriangularSolve.Execution Real → TriangularSolve.Execution Real) x_1
    (fun x f x_2 =>
      (match (motive :=
          TriangularSolve.Execution Real →
            (x : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} Real Real)) →
              List.below.{1, 0} (motive := fun x => TriangularSolve.Execution Real → TriangularSolve.Execution Real) x →
                TriangularSolve.Execution Real)
          x_2, x with
        | acc, List.nil.{0} => fun x => acc
        | acc, List.cons.{0} (Prod.mk.{0, 0} a b) rest => fun x =>
          let p := TriangularSolve.perform ar TriangularSolve.Operation.mul a b;
          let s :=
            TriangularSolve.perform ar TriangularSolve.Operation.add (TriangularSolve.Execution.value acc)
              (TriangularSolve.Execution.value p);
          x.1
            { value := TriangularSolve.Execution.value s,
              calls :=
                HAppend.hAppend.{0, 0, 0}
                  (HAppend.hAppend.{0, 0, 0} (TriangularSolve.Execution.calls acc) (TriangularSolve.Execution.calls p))
                  (TriangularSolve.Execution.calls s) })
        f)
    x

declarations.name: TriangularSolve.solution_of_a_triangular_system
declarations.type:
∀ (n : Nat) (direction : TriangularSolve.Direction) (ar : TriangularSolve.Arithmetic)
  (T : Matrix.{0, 0, 0} (Fin n) (Fin n) Real) (b : Fin n → Real) (u : Real),
  LE.le.{0} 0 u →
    LT.lt.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑n) u) 1 →
      Ne.{1} (Matrix.det.{0, 0} T) 0 →
        TriangularSolve.IsTriangular direction T →
          TriangularSolve.Execution.SatisfiesModel (TriangularSolve.substitution direction ar T b) ar u →
            ∃ Δ,
              And
                (Eq.{1}
                  (Matrix.mulVec.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} T Δ)
                    (TriangularSolve.Execution.value (TriangularSolve.substitution direction ar T b)))
                  b)
                (And
                  (∀ (i j : Fin n),
                    LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} (Δ i j)) (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (TriangularSolve.gamma n u) (abs.{0} (T i j))))
                  (TriangularSolve.IsTriangular direction Δ))

fun {n} direction ar T b =>
  match direction with
  | TriangularSolve.Direction.lower => TriangularSolve.forwardSubstitution ar T b
  | TriangularSolve.Direction.upper => TriangularSolve.backwardSubstitution ar T b
